url.description: Absolute public URL for the built site.
url.markdownDescription:
```yaml
url: https://example.com/
```

The absolute public URL. Its path also determines the base path for generated links and assets.

[Public URL reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#url)

language.description: Site language tag using Norna's English or Swedish interface text; the default is en.

oneOf.title: English
oneOf.description: Use Norna's built-in English interface text.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Use Norna's built-in English interface text.

[Language reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#language)

oneOf.title: Swedish
oneOf.description: Use Norna's built-in Swedish interface text.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Use Norna's built-in Swedish interface text.

[Language reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#language)

oneOf.title: Regional language tag
oneOf.description: Use an English or Swedish regional language tag such as en-GB or sv-SE.

language.markdownDescription:
```yaml
language: en-GB
```

Sets the page language and selects Norna's built-in English or Swedish interface text. The default is `en`.

[Language reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#language)

baseUrl.description: Absolute edit URL prefix containing the repository, branch, and any repository subdirectory.
baseUrl.markdownDescription:
```yaml
editLink:
  baseUrl: https://github.com/owner/repository/edit/main/
```

Optional absolute remote edit URL prefix. Include any repository subdirectory and branch. Norna adds the project-relative path to each page's `content.md` file. This destination is used by published output and LAN previews.

[Edit-link reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#edit-link)

localEditor.description: Editor used by source links in a development preview opened through a loopback address.

oneOf.title: Visual Studio Code
oneOf.description: Open the current page source in the locally installed Visual Studio Code application.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Open the current page source in the locally installed Visual Studio Code application.

[Edit-link reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#edit-link)

localEditor.markdownDescription:
```yaml
editLink:
  localEditor: vscode
```

Optional editor for a development preview opened through localhost or another loopback address. `vscode` opens the absolute page source path through VS Code's registered URL handler. The setting is never emitted as a local path in published output.

[Edit-link reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#edit-link)

editLink.description: Optional local and remote links from rendered pages to their Markdown source files.
editLink.markdownDescription:
```yaml
editLink:
  localEditor: vscode
  baseUrl: https://github.com/owner/repository/edit/main/
```

Links each rendered page to its `content.md` source. A loopback development preview uses the explicitly selected local editor; published output and LAN previews use the optional remote base URL. Specify either destination or both.

[Edit-link reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#edit-link)

defaultSnippets.label: Local and remote source links
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription:
Open page source in VS Code during same-computer development and on the remote source host elsewhere.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#edit-link)

mode.description: Navigation model. Omit this to let Norna choose from the site structure.

oneOf.title: Automatic
oneOf.description: Choose sections for one page, top navigation for a flat multi-page site, and a stable left rail throughout a site with listed child pages or categories.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Choose sections for one page, top navigation for a flat multi-page site, and a stable left rail throughout a site with listed child pages or categories.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/pages.md#navigation)

oneOf.title: Sections
oneOf.description: Navigate the sections of the current page.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Navigate the sections of the current page.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/pages.md#navigation)

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: Use pages in the top navigation and sections below them.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Use pages in the top navigation and sections below them.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/pages.md#navigation)

oneOf.title: Tree
oneOf.description: Use a left page rail and a separate right H2/H3 contents rail where the page has enough headings.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Use a left page rail and a separate right H2/H3 contents rail where the page has enough headings.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/pages.md#navigation)

mode.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  mode: automatic
```

Navigation model. Omit this to let Norna choose from the site structure.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/pages.md#navigation)

navigation.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  mode: automatic
```

Sets the site-wide navigation policy. `automatic` uses sections for one page, top navigation for a flat multi-page site, and a stable left rail throughout a hierarchical site.

[Navigation reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/pages.md#navigation)

search.description: Generate a static site search page and Pagefind index. The default is false.
search.markdownDescription:
```yaml
search: true
```

Generates a localized `/search/` page and a static Pagefind index during each build. Search is off by default, and only the search page loads the search JavaScript.

[Search reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#search)

scrollBehavior.description: Use instant anchors by default or the browser's native smooth scrolling.

oneOf.title: Instant
oneOf.description: Jump directly to anchors without animated scrolling. This is the default.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Jump directly to anchors without animated scrolling. This is the default.

[Scroll behavior reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#scrollbehavior)

oneOf.title: Browser smooth
oneOf.description: Use the browser's native smooth scrolling for anchor navigation.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Use the browser's native smooth scrolling for anchor navigation.

[Scroll behavior reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#scrollbehavior)

scrollBehavior.markdownDescription:
```yaml
scrollBehavior: smooth
```

Controls same-page anchor movement. `instant` is the default; `smooth` uses the browser's native smooth scrolling.

[Scroll behavior reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/configuration.md#scrollbehavior)
